facts: Picking Circle closes the tiles (no listbox open after) and the picker then shows a circle.
The Corner row (Uniform and Individual corner radii, the radius field) is gone with Circle picked: Ratio moves from panel y 287 to 231 (56 up), and every row under it the same.

The block does not change: rows 10 at 6 columns, size 341.7 by 399.9 and every leaf the same before and after; no element of the block has a clip-path. The empty image placeholder is all the block draws there.

Scored, with no oracle (the reads of CAP-T12PRESS-C.json): the frozen rows rule of CAP-T12NEWSLETTER.json, with content the lowest leaf box, on Menu's three presses gets 0 of 3. Typed text: content 178.9, rule 4 rows, read 7. Centered: 340.6, rule 9, read 10. Euro: content the same, rule 8 (it shrinks 10 to floor), read 10. Not built: Menu's rows stay a named miss.
